subject: microbiology
title: Novobiocin Testing and Mannitol Salt Agar in Staphylococcal Identification

steps.tx: The **novobiocin test** drops a 5 microgram disc on a coagulase negative staphylococcus lawn: susceptible zones (16 mm and above) suggest the epidermidis group, resistance names saprophyticus among urinary isolates (its gyrase naturally less susceptible). One disc routes the commonest CoNS bench fork in urinary work.
steps.say: Resistant to novobiocin in urine: think saprophyticus; susceptible: epidermidis group.

left.title: Novobiocin logic
points: 5 ug disc on Mueller Hinton or blood agar
Susceptible: S epidermidis and most CoNS
Confirm species when site is sterile

right.title: Bench cautions
points: Some other CoNS share resistance (cohnii group)

steps.tx: **Mannitol salt agar** from the aureus lesson doubles as CoNS stage: non fermenters grow pink unchanged, so a yellow colony demands coagulase confirmation while pink colonies travel to novobiocin and speciation. Reading both media together is the staphylococcal bench's opening two moves.
steps.say: MSA yellow asks coagulase; MSA pink asks novobiocin and species.

left.title: MSA reads
points: No growth: salt intolerant, not staphylococcus

right.title: Opening sequence
points: Novobiocin and speciation for CoNS by site

steps.tx: **Chromogenic MRSA media** modernise screening: cefoxitin containing chromogenic agar turns MRSA colonies a proprietary colour in 18 to 24 hours from nasal swabs, sensitivity rivalled by PCR where speed pays (pre surgical, outbreak), cost deciding between them. Culture retains isolate recovery for typing that PCR cannot hand over.
steps.say: Chromogenic plates colour MRSA by morning; PCR answers by lunch without an isolate.

left.title: Chromogenic culture
points: Isolate kept for typing and susceptibility

right.title: Molecular screening
points: Pooled swab programmes in some units

steps.tx: **PYR and rapid kits** compress speciation: pyrrolidonyl arylamidase positive lugdunensis among CoNS, latex agglutination (clumping factor, protein A, capsular antigens) for aureus in minutes from colonies, and automated panels finishing what discs begin. Rapid tests route therapy days earlier in blood culture workflows (mecA and PBP2a from positive bottles).
steps.say: Minutes from colony to aureus answer: latex and PBP2a kits rewired the first day.

left.title: Rapid colony tests
points: Latex: clumping factor and protein A
PYR spot: lugdunensis and enterococcus clues

right.title: From positive blood culture
points: Stewardship acts same day on these

steps.tx: **Antimicrobial discs for staphylococci** carry species specific traps: cefoxitin surrogate for mecA, penicillin zone edge test for beta lactamase (sharp cliff versus fuzzy beach), erythromycin clindamycin D zone, vancomycin MIC only (disc blind to VISA), each expert rule from the susceptibility module applied to this genus.
steps.say: Staphylococcal reports are expert rules in action: edges, D zones and MIC only vancomycin.

left.title: Disc rules
points: Penicillin zone edge: beta lactamase if sharp
Fusidic and rifampicin never report alone (resistance speed)

right.title: MIC only drugs
points: Linezolid disc and MIC both valid
Reference labs arbitrate VISA and rare resistance

steps.tx: **Typing for outbreaks** (spa sequence of protein A repeats, PFGE heritage, whole genome SNP) decides whether MRSA isolates are one transmission or many importations, directing infection control theatre toward wards or admissions. Protein A returns as epidemiologist's barcode, its third career in one module.
steps.say: Protein A binds antibody, carries test kits and barcodes outbreaks: three careers, one molecule.

nodes.label: Cases cluster in time and ward

steps.tx: **Reporting language** disciplines prescribers: CoNS reported with site aware comments (possible contaminant versus probable pathogen), aureus always fully worked, mecA positive reported as resistant to all beta lactams except ceftaroline class, and inducible clindamycin reported resistant with comment. The report is a prescription consultation.
steps.say: Comments on staphylococcal reports prescribe as surely as drug names do.

left.title: Report habits
points: Number of sets positive stated for CoNS
Time to positivity available on request

right.title: Therapy echoes
points: MSSA: cefazolin or antistaph penicillin preferred over vancomycin
MRSA: vancomycin AUC, daptomycin not in pneumonia
CoNS devices: glycopeptide plus removal plan

steps.tx: **Novobiocin in history** also treated infections (gyrase B inhibitor) before resistance and toxicity shelved it, surviving only as this identification disc, a common fate for antibiotics turned reagents (bacitracin, optochin in the streptococcal lessons follow). Bench discs are retired drugs with second careers.
steps.say: Half the bench's discs are retired antibiotics; identification is their second career.

right.title: Why retired
points: Resistance speed or toxicity as therapy
